title: 第11章 神通法术第12章 聚会
content_zh:
;;
鬼知道这女人一天天的发的什么疯，莫名其妙的还给我降好感度了。
那自己之前岂不是白帮你了？
母胎单身的云阳表示自己不懂女人心。
此人如此反复无常，我这么帮她她却还给我降低好感度。
她这是农夫与蛇，东郭先生与狼，吕洞宾与狗，郝建与老太太啊这是！
罢了，大不了以后不再帮她了。
与此同时，屏幕、也是墙的另一边……
“砰！”
苏沐雪的拳头重重的捶在墙上。
可恶！
为什么在面对这个男人时，自己的心境总是如此不稳？
盘膝坐在蒲团上，正在打坐的苏沐雪强行让自己沉下心来。
区区云阳……自己怎么能因为他而心境不稳？
苏沐雪啊苏沐雪，你前世修行千万年的心性难道都修行到狗身上去了么？
“呼~”
苏沐雪长舒一口气，摇了摇头。
罢了，以后专心修炼，少与他来往好了。
等到修为上去了，再把这厮踩在脚下！
这一夜，不同的人有不同的想法，这注定是一个……

啊不，好像云阳又接了灵药峰看管药园的任务，化身肝帝吃他的小零食去了。
看我吃灵虫吃到吃到大乘期！
想象是美好的，现实是残酷的，不然这本小说就得叫《我靠吃灵虫吃到大乘期》了。
突破到炼气期四层后，云阳发现，吃灵虫已经不能再给自己带来收益了。
就算自己再怎么吃，都好像不再增长气属性了。
而且……
【你喜欢生吃灵虫的事情开始在外门传播开来，越来越多的玄天门弟子开始知道你的存在，只不过他们对你的印象似乎并不怎么好……】
云阳感觉这些个玄天门的弟子是不是有点八婆了？我特么吃个虫子怎么还被人评论指点上了？
那个苏沐雪也是，大家身为同乡，自己还曾在入门考核里帮过她，她凭什么降低对自己的好感度？
凌晨肝游戏到炼气期四层的云阳突然有些气不过，看着游戏里又过了一天，云阳决定怎么着也得报复回来。
有仇就报才是我云某人的忍道！
云阳突然想起来，刚来玄天门时，自己曾在灵舟上通过戳屏幕戳苏沐雪的脸来着。
自己现在是不是也能戳呢？
想干就干，云阳直接划动屏幕划到苏沐雪房间门口。
点击苏沐雪的房门，随即弹出了三个选项：
【选项1：敲门】
content_en:
;;
Who knows what kind of madness this woman is getting every day, and she even lowers my favorability level inexplicably.
Then didn’t I help you in vain?
Yunyang, who was born single, said that he did not understand women's hearts.
This person is so capricious, and I helped her so much, but she still lowered my favorability.
This is the farmer and the snake, Mr. Dongguo and the wolf, Lu Dongbin and the dog, Hao Jian and the old lady! This is it!
That's all, the worst case scenario is that I won't help her anymore.
At the same time, the screen is also the other side of the wall...
"Bang!"
Su Muxue's fist hit the wall hard.
hateful!
Why is my state of mind always so unstable when facing this man?
Sitting cross-legged on the futon, Su Muxue, who was meditating, forced herself to calm down.
Just Yunyang...how could I feel unstable because of him?
Su Muxue, Su Muxue, has the character you cultivated for thousands of years in your previous life been transferred to dogs?
"Huh~"
Su Muxue breathed a long sigh of relief and shook her head.
That's all, from now on, just concentrate on your cultivation and have less contact with him.
Wait until your cultivation level goes up, then trample this guy under your feet!
This night, different people have different ideas, this is destined to be a...
Ah no, it seems that Yunyang has taken over the task of taking care of the medicine garden at the Spiritual Medicine Peak and transformed into the Liver Emperor to eat his snacks.
Watch me eat spiritual worms until I reach the Mahayana stage!
Imagination is beautiful, but reality is cruel, otherwise this novel would have been called "I Reached the Mahayana Stage by Eating Spirit Insects".
After breaking through to the fourth level of the Qi Refining Stage, Yunyang discovered that eating spiritual insects could no longer bring him any benefits.
No matter how much I eat, it seems that my Qi attribute is no longer increasing.
And...
[The fact that you like to eat spiritual insects alive has begun to spread in the outer sect, and more and more Xuantian sect disciples have begun to know of your existence, but their impression of you does not seem to be very good...]
Yunyang felt that these Xuantianmen disciples were a bit bitch? Why am I still being criticized by others for eating such a worm?
The same goes for Su Muxue. We are all from the same hometown and he helped her in the entrance examination. Why should she lower her favorability towards him?
Yunyang, who had reached the fourth level of the Qi Refining Stage in the liver game in the early morning, suddenly became a little angry. Seeing another day pass in the game, Yunyang decided to come back with revenge no matter what.
Revenge when you have a grudge is the way of tolerance for someone like me, Yun!
Yunyang suddenly remembered that when he first came to Xuantianmen, he had poked Su Muxue in the face on the spirit boat by poking at the screen.
Can I poke it myself now?
Whatever he wanted to do, Yunyang swiped the screen directly to the door of Su Muxue's room.
Clicking on Su Muxue's door, three options popped up:
[Option 1: Knock on the door]
